records.working_title: Safe Adaptivity in Dollar-Cost Averaging: From an Impossibility Boundary to a Reproducible Empirical Evaluation
records.narrative: A universal-superiority ambition is bounded by causal impossibility, relaxed into an exact safety architecture, implemented as a guarded adaptive policy, and tested by a frozen reproducible evaluation whose negative signal result is retained.

research_questions.question: Can a sequentially admissible, fully funded strategy universally dominate the same-deposit DCA comparator?
research_questions.conservative_answer: No economically distinct strategy can: universal pathwise dominance forces the strategy to purchase exactly as DCA.

research_questions.question: Can an economically distinct adaptive strategy retain a transparent, model-free relative-wealth floor?
research_questions.conservative_answer: Yes in the frictionless comparison model: the epsilon-DCA unit guardrail gives the sharp causal floor and leaves a funded discretionary allocation when epsilon is positive.

research_questions.question: Does the guarded corrected-mean score add empirical value inside that safety architecture?
research_questions.conservative_answer: Not in the frozen historical evaluation: the floor is confirmed operationally, but incremental value from the corrected-mean signal is not confirmed.

records.title: Introduction
records.purpose: Frame the Financial Computing problem, the three research questions, the safety-versus-adaptivity narrative, the contribution boundary, and the route through the thesis.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader understands why fair DCA accounting changes the original superiority ambition and knows the precise questions the thesis answers.
records.placement_rule: Keep motivation, research questions, conservative answers, contributions, non-claims, and chapter route in the body; defer proof details and supplementary validation to appendices.

records.title: Literature and Research Positioning
records.purpose: Position DCA and adaptive accumulation, generalized and Bajraktarevic means, causal portfolio safety, and reproducible computational finance against primary literature.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader can distinguish prior theory, project-specific results, methodological choices, and claims the thesis explicitly does not make.
records.placement_rule: Keep the comparative synthesis and direct support for manuscript claims in the body; place exhaustive search logs and extended source tables outside the body or in supplementary material.

records.title: Financial Model and Corrected Signal Foundations
records.purpose: Define the same-deposit comparison model, exact cash-inclusive accounting, the source-functional defect, the corrected mean, and the lagged dimensionless signal.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader can reconstruct the financial comparison and understand why the corrected mean is a known Bajraktarevic construction used as a signal rather than a newly claimed mean class.
records.placement_rule: Keep definitions, decisive equations, compatibility identities, and interpretation in the body; place full classification, diagonal-limit, and homogeneity proofs in the mathematical-proof appendix.

records.title: Causal Impossibility and Safety Architecture
records.purpose: Establish the universal DCA impossibility boundary, derive the sharp epsilon-DCA unit guardrail, and define the guarded corrected-mean policy with the guarantee assigned only to the floor.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader understands why universal superiority collapses to DCA and how a controlled relaxation creates safe adaptive freedom.
records.placement_rule: Keep theorem statements, assumptions, proof ideas, the guardrail recursion, and policy algorithm in the body; place adversarial-continuation and equivalence proofs in the proof appendix.

records.title: Exact Performance Boundaries
records.purpose: Present the two- and three-purchase classifications, arbitrary-horizon cash-timing identity, qualified cash single-crossing mechanism, and terminal-inventory boundary.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader can separate a model-free floor from ledger-conditioned realized win, tie, and loss regions at every finite horizon.
records.placement_rule: Keep necessary-and-sufficient classifications, decisive witnesses, and economic interpretation in the body; move exhaustive branch cases and exact-rational replay detail to the boundary appendix.

records.title: Empirical Methodology and Reproducibility
records.purpose: Describe the frozen protocol, three-policy comparisons, deterministic and stochastic constructions, historical source seam, rolling episodes, dependence-aware inference, cost scopes, and immutable artifact identities.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader can identify every inferential unit, reproduce public results, and see why evidence layers and confirmatory versus robustness analyses cannot be pooled.
records.placement_rule: Keep hypotheses, estimands, comparison tiers, source semantics, statistical plan, and reproduction overview in the body; place full protocols, receipts, and validation schemas in the empirical-method appendix.

records.title: Deterministic and Stochastic Evaluation
records.purpose: Report exact deterministic/adversarial mechanisms and seeded stochastic sensitivity without treating catalog signs or three-seed summaries as population frequencies.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader sees concrete favorable and adverse mechanisms, parameter sensitivity, and the distinction among complete-system, signal-only, and architecture-only effects.
records.placement_rule: Keep headline tables, mechanism figures, downside summaries, and bounded interpretation in the body; place complete catalogs, sensitivities, and validation output in supplementary-results appendices.

records.title: Historical Evaluation and Robustness
records.purpose: Report the sealed SPY and BTC-USD confirmatory evaluation and the separately registered descriptive robustness extension under their declared inferential limits.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader understands the negative primary finding, the absence of confirmed incremental signal value, and why robustness outcomes do not rewrite the preregistration.
records.placement_rule: Keep primary estimates, intervals, multiplicity conclusions, decisive robustness summaries, and limitations in the body; place full cell tables and private-data receipt detail in appendices or the repository package.

records.title: Safety, Adaptivity, and Limitations
records.purpose: Integrate analytical and empirical evidence into the central safety-versus-adaptivity finding and state the theorem, cost, data, inference, and generalization limits.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader can state what is guaranteed, what was observed, what was not confirmed, and which future questions require new registered research.
records.placement_rule: Keep cross-layer synthesis and decision-relevant limitations in the body; do not introduce new analyses or hide unattractive outcomes in appendices.

records.title: Conclusions
records.purpose: Answer the three research questions in order, summarize contributions and non-claims, and identify a clean future-research frontier.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader leaves with a concise, defensible statement of the thesis result rather than a generalized performance promise.
records.placement_rule: Keep only supported answers, contributions, limitations, and future work in the body; exclude new evidence, proofs, or outcome-driven reinterpretation.

records.title: Mathematical Proofs
records.purpose: Preserve complete proofs for the source classification, corrected-mean properties, impossibility theorem, and safety equivalence.
records.intended_reader_outcome: A specialist can audit every body theorem without the proof machinery displacing the Financial Computing narrative.
records.placement_rule: Include full derivations and boundary cases here; retain concise theorem meaning and proof ideas in the body.

records.title: Exact Performance Cases and Witnesses
records.purpose: Collect exhaustive finite-horizon branches, exact witnesses, cash-crossing counterexamples, and arbitrary-horizon replay detail.
records.intended_reader_outcome: A reviewer can verify sharpness and edge cases without inferring a broader performance law.
records.placement_rule: Place exhaustive cases and long exact calculations here; keep decisive thresholds and representative witnesses in the body.

records.title: Empirical Protocols and Statistical Controls
records.purpose: Record frozen grids, hypotheses, episode mapping, exclusions, block bootstrap, Holm correction, robustness registration, and cost-scope rules.
records.intended_reader_outcome: A statistical reviewer can audit the design and confirm that outcomes did not silently alter the inferential plan.
records.placement_rule: Include protocol detail and supplementary diagnostics here; keep estimands and decisive inference in the body.

records.title: Reproducibility and Artifact Provenance
records.purpose: Bind software, commands, immutable run identities, source receipts, generated assets, and public/private evidence boundaries.
records.intended_reader_outcome: An archive reader can reproduce public artifacts and verify retained private evidence without hidden conversation context.
records.placement_rule: Put long command listings, manifests, checksums, and receipt tables here; keep the reproducibility claim and minimal route in the body.

records.title: Supplementary Tables and Figures
records.purpose: Hold complete generated tables and figures whose size or detail would interrupt the body.
records.intended_reader_outcome: The reader can inspect complete result coverage while the body retains only decision-relevant views.
records.placement_rule: Move tables or figures larger than half a page and exhaustive grids here; every item remains numbered, referenced, attributed, and generated from reviewed evidence.
